test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The interest rates offered depends on the bank, deposit amount and the tenure you choose.

B. It not only helps you to save money but also helps you to earn a substantial interest on it.

C. One of the best ways to secure your money is by investing in fixed deposits.

D. Under the fixed deposit scheme, the depositor deposits the money only once at the time of opening the account.
solution:
​The correct answer is '**CDBA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• **Sentence C** will be the first sentence because it is an independent introductory sentence that tells us about the fixed deposits.
 
• **Sentence D** will be the next sentence because it explains what is a fixed deposit.
 
• **Sentence B** will be used afterward because it is connected with the previous sentence.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence A** will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **C**: One of the best ways to secure your money is by investing in fixed deposits.
 
• **D**: Under the fixed deposit scheme, the depositor deposits the money only once at the time of opening the account.
 
• **B**: It not only helps you to save money but also helps you to earn a substantial interest on it.
 
• **A**: The interest rates offered depends on the bank, deposit amount and the tenure you choose.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *One of the best ways to secure your money is by investing in fixed deposits. Under the fixed deposit scheme, the depositor deposits the money only once at the time of opening the account. It not only helps you to save money but also helps you to earn a substantial interest on it. The interest rates offered depends on the bank, deposit amount and the tenure you choose.*
